# Shock Doctor

> > Shock Doctor is a leading sports protection brand specializing in advanced mouthguard technology and protective equipment for athletes across multiple sports.

Shock Doctor offers a comprehensive range of mouthguards and protective gear designed for various sports and athlete needs, including specialized products for different fit types, sports disciplines, and dental conditions. The brand features innovative protection technologies like Gel Max and MicroGel, along with popular flavored options.

## Mouthguard Fit Types

- [Instant Fit Mouthguards | Shock Doctor](https://www.shockdoctor.com/collections/instant-fit-mouthguards): Instant fit mouthguards requiring no molding, ready to use out of packaging.
- [Classic Fit Mouthguards | Shock Doctor](https://www.shockdoctor.com/collections/mouthguards-fit-classic): Classic fit mouthguards collection including Gel Max and Insta-Fit products.
- [Slim Fit Mouthguards | Shock Doctor](https://www.shockdoctor.com/collections/mouthguards-fit-slim): Slim fit mouthguards collection including MicroFit and Trash Talker products.
- [Braces-Fit Mouthguards - Max Protection For High Impact Sports – Shock Doctor](https://www.shockdoctor.com/collections/mouthguards-fit-braces): Braces-compatible mouthguards collection for athletes wearing dental braces.
